answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the anchor queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. The kernel index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1679 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the zephyr. Bonded capital sits idle for 18 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
